scope: Voice input recognition, LLM response, cancellation, Web lifecycle, and operational logging

observed.qualification: Cancellation is proved by correlation IDs. Logs do not distinguish a stop button from UI cleanup or configuration revocation, nor the UI trigger of a turn cancellation. The last live voice request subsequently completed generation and reached ready with played acknowledgements, but this was not this task's hardware acceptance.

findings.problem: Old microphone callbacks, a rejected old upload, and a delayed stop could alter a newly started voice session or remove its query.
findings.fix: Fence callbacks, upload errors and retries to their own session. Clear the old query before asynchronous stop work, ignore late audio-state notifications, and render active state explicitly.
findings.baseline: Old callbacks changed the new recognition ID; a delayed stop removed the new turn. Both were reproduced in failing regression tests.

findings.problem: The preceding answer was cancelled before the next upload was accepted, even when the next upload was rejected.
findings.fix: Cancel after successful acceptance; on failure drop unsent segments and provisional previews, restore the previous turn, and reload it for playback, including two queued segments. Immediate interruption during playback is preserved.
findings.baseline: Regression test observed an unwanted voiceCancel call on rejected replacement.

findings.problem: Intentional cancellation was recorded as network_unavailable.
findings.fix: Record caller cancellation as larm.inference_cancelled at info; keep actual network failures as warn.

findings.problem: Full verification found a direct settings type import forbidden by the domain graph.
findings.fix: Derive the necessary prompt settings type from the public InferencePort snapshot contract. Prompt behavior is unchanged.

findings.problem: A test assumed millisecond timestamps uniquely order attempts; it read an older, unaccepted attempt during fast fixture execution.
findings.fix: Identify the replay attempt by its newly created ID instead of its position.

findings.problem: Browser checks used the previous default settings heading and old intonation label.
findings.fix: Match the current general settings heading and the expanded intonation/speed/pitch label.

fixture.previousFull: backend 194 and Web 54 passed; browser 9 passed, 3 failed (two outdated UI selectors and one SSE count check during source changes)
fixture.browserStandalone: pass: all 12 browser fixture tests, 1.1 min
fixture.avatarQualification: Two earlier combined runs failed the canvas removal assertion. The isolated rendering test, the standalone 12-test suite, and the final combined gate passed. The intermediate rendering instability itself was not causally explained; diagnostic navigation state is now captured on failure.

verification.live: Existing diagnostic logs only; no new provider probe
verification.hardware: Not performed; three-turn microphone/headphone acceptance remains open
verification.runtime: No production backend restart was performed. Web uses the existing development server; a production build/deployment is outside this code repair.
